faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the JNPA Pilot recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the JNPA Pilot recruitment is 12th October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Pilot post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master (FG) Certificate of Competency and have at least one year of sailing experience as Chief Officer or above on Foreign Going ships.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the JNPA Pilot position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Pilot post is 55 years. There are no specific minimum age limits mentioned for this position.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Pilot role at JNPA?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Pilot position at JNPA involves an interview, which can be conducted either in person or online.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Pilot post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Pilot post is offered under two schemes: Scheme I ranges from Rs. 1,50,000 to Rs. 3,75,000 per month, and Scheme II offers Rs. 13,000 to Rs. 27,000 per day.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for the JNPA Pilot recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for the JNPA Pilot recruitment. Both General/OBC and SC/ST categories are exempt from paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Pilot post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Pilot post announced by the Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the JNPA Pilot recruitment is through email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents via email.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this JNPA recruitment?
faq.answer: The job type for the Pilot position at JNPA is contract-based employment.

faq.question: Q10. Where is JNPA located?
faq.answer: Jawaharlal Nehru Port Authority (JNPA) is located in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, with the pincode 400702.
